howItWorks.title: How It
howItWorks.subtitle: A clear path from where you are today to where you can go: progressive readiness, not one-off luck.

step1.title: Activate
step1.description: Join MAALI, complete your profile, and identify the right opportunity: grant, job, training, scholarship, loan, or enterprise support.

step2.title: Optimise
step2.description: Strengthen eligibility: documents, records, cash-flow clarity, and fit. Use guides, mentors, and guided applications.

step3.title: Apply with confidence
step3.description: Submit through multi-step applications with drafts, uploads, and clear requirements.

step4.title: Scale & track
step4.description: Follow review outcomes, build a track record, and progress toward larger formal opportunities: funding, loans, roles, or investment readiness.

progression.title: From informal activity
progression.body: Many productive people are overlooked because their work is under-documented. MAALI helps members build practices and evidence (sales and expenses, clearer costing, stronger applications) so partners, programmes, and financiers can assess them fairly, including for productive loans where those pathways exist.
progression.qualify3: Readiness for grants, jobs, loans, procurement, and investment pathways
progression.qualify4: Partner programmes that unlock capital, loans, or placement where available

spotlight.title: Spotlight: Agribusiness & productive enterprise
spotlight.body: With partners like Green Agric Technology (GAT) and youth-in-agribusiness programmes, MAALI can onboard cohorts, profile members, match opportunities (including productive loans where partners offer them), and track outcomes: Activate, Optimise, Scale. The same platform serves founders and professionals in every other sector we list.

about.title: About Maali
about.hero: MAALI Opportunity Hub is more than a listings site. It is a trusted bridge connecting African entrepreneurs, farmers, traders, professionals, students, and interns with grants, jobs, internships, trainings, scholarships, fellowships, and enterprise-readiness pathways across the continent.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Connect African talent and viable enterprises with accessible opportunities (funding, jobs, learning, and enterprise support) and the skills, records, and evidence needed to grow.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: An Africa where every productive person has a clear path from informal or early-stage activity to formal, investable opportunity across farms, markets, startups, and careers.

empowerment.title: Empowerment
empowerment.description: Opening doors for founders, professionals, students, and interns to access programs that advance their ventures and careers.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: Modern, clear tools that help applicants discover programs and submit strong applications with confidence.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Connecting applicants, program partners, and expert reviewers in one ecosystem built on trust and transparency.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Driving real outcomes (grants, placements, fellowships, and career growth) for communities across Africa.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Maali was born from a simple observation: Africa is home to extraordinary talent, yet many founders, professionals, students, and interns still struggle to find and apply for the right opportunities.
story.p2: Our name Maali relates to wealth and value in Somali, reflecting economic opportunity and career growth, not aid alone.
story.p3: Through technology, membership, and a fair review process, we help African talent discover programs, apply with confidence, and track outcomes on one platform.
story.ctaDescription: Be part of the hub connecting African talent to grants, jobs, internships, trainings, and more.

guidePage.title: Application Guide
guidePage.subtitle: A step-by-step guide to help you successfully apply for funding opportunities on Maali.
guidePage.introDesc: This guide will walk you through the entire application process, from creating your account to submitting your application. Follow these steps to maximize your chances of success.
mistakes: Submitting incomplete applications or missing required documents
Waiting until the last minute to submit your application
Not reading the opportunity requirements carefully
Not responding to requests for additional information
guidePage.resourcesDesc: Explore these additional resources to help you succeed with your application.

steps.title: Create Your Account
steps.description: Start by creating a free account on Maali. You can sign up with your email or use Google for faster registration.

steps.title: Complete Your Profile
steps.description: Fill out your profile with accurate business information. A complete profile increases your chances of approval.

steps.title: Browse Opportunities
steps.description: Explore available funding opportunities. Use filters to find opportunities that match your business sector and needs.

steps.title: Prepare Your Documents
steps.description: Gather all required documents before starting your application. This includes business plans, financial statements, and identification.

steps.title: Submit Your Application
steps.description: Complete the multi-step application form. Take your time to provide accurate and detailed information.
tips: Save your progress if you need to return later

steps.title: Track Your Application
steps.description: Monitor your application status from your dashboard. You'll receive email notifications when there are updates.
tips: Respond promptly to any requests for additional information
Be patient during the review process

bestPractices.title: Be Honest and Accurate
bestPractices.description: Provide truthful information about your business. Misrepresentation can lead to application rejection or future issues.

bestPractices.title: Prepare in Advance
bestPractices.description: Gather all required documents before starting your application to avoid delays and ensure completeness.

bestPractices.title: Follow Instructions
bestPractices.description: Read all instructions carefully and follow them precisely. Each opportunity may have specific requirements.

bestPractices.title: Meet Deadlines
bestPractices.description: Submit your application well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues and ensure your application is considered.
